reference: Original World of Warcraft 1.12 UI artwork; visual reference only, not a Forever gameplay data assertion
nativeScale: One source pixel per CSS pixel on desktop unless explicitly noted; responsive panels may scale down at narrow widths.

WowFrame.method: Eight separate 32px SVG viewport crops, fixed corners and tiled edges; top/bottom slices rotated 90 degrees; tiled native background; header uses occupied 139x40 crop with fixed 10px caps and repeated center

WowButton.method: Crop the 80x23 occupied button from 128x32 atlas; border-image keeps edge caps, extends red interior
WowButton.derivedStates: Disabled uses desaturation; selected uses highlight and outline. Native Up/Down/Highlight remain exact.

IconSlot.method: 40px native border crop, icon inset, separate radial cooldown mask and text overlays

UnitFrame.method: 193px native frame crops; player portrait on left, target portrait on right; clipped native race portrait; health/resource fills under transparent art

WowTooltip.method: Eight 16px crops with fixed corners and tiled edges; focus/hover/Escape; authored dark readable backdrop

ActionBar.method: Native central blank stone strip, native 128px endcaps mirrored for right; wraps slots for smaller screens

Minimap.method: Separate native ring and title crops; circular map crop; marker callback supplied by caller

ProgressBar.method: Native grayscale fill tinted by presentation tone, clamped finite percentage, accessible meter

WorkbenchPaperDoll.method: Four native tiles at original size; overlaid equipment slots

WorkbenchBag.method: 191x240 crop; icons inset into original baked 4x4 slots; no duplicate slot frames

WorkbenchQuest.method: Four native tiles at original size; 354x446 visible panel; authored German typography and sample text

WorkbenchTalents.method: Four native quadrants at original size, clipped to 280x352 viewport
WorkbenchTalents.limitation: Visual layout specimen only. Does not model actual talent positions, ranks or prerequisites.

authoredAssets.author: project
authoredAssets.purpose: Clearly missing icon fallback; manually drawn

authoredAssets.author: project
authoredAssets.purpose: Generic unavailable-map placeholder; manually drawn, not geographic data

authoredAssets.author: project
authoredAssets.purpose: Manual armor silhouette for paperdoll; not an original game model

rules: Props convey display and callbacks only. Cooldown is a caller-supplied fraction, never a timer or automatic disabled rule. No combat, inventory, quest, talent or simulation behavior is implemented here.
